entries.en: Wait... don't tell me that's a Jinguji dress.
entries.ro: Stai... nu-mi spune că-i rochie Jinguji.

entries.en: How the... how did you get this? Did you sell your kidney or something?
entries.ro: Cum dracu'... cum ai făcut rost de ea? Ți-ai vândut un rinichi sau ce?

entries.en: For the record, it's gorgeous, but... that many eddies...? Was it really worth it?
entries.ro: Să știi că-i superbă, da'... atâția eddies...? Chiar a meritat?

entries.en: I've got no regrets... There's no shame in wanting perfection.
entries.ro: N-am niciun regret... Nu-i rușine să vrei perfecțiune.
